title: Dinosaurs
description: Nam and Linh visit a dinosaur museum with their class.
instructions: Read about the trip to the Dinosaur Museum. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🦕 Last Saturday, Nam and his sister Linh went to the Dinosaur Museum with their class. They were very excited because they love dinosaurs. Their teacher, Mr Brown, gave everyone a map.
In the first room, there was a huge skeleton of a Diplodocus. It was twenty-seven metres long, and its neck was very long. It ate only plants. Linh said, 'It is as long as three buses!'
The next room was Nam's favourite. It had a model of a Tyrannosaurus rex, which had sharp teeth and very small arms. Scientists think it could run quite fast. Nam took a photo next to its big feet.

After that, they went to a room where children could look for fossils. A fossil is a part of an animal that died millions of years ago and turned into stone. Linh found a small fossil of a shell. She was very happy.

At twelve o'clock, they had lunch in the garden. Mia, Nam's friend, asked, 'Why did the dinosaurs disappear?' Mr Brown said, 'Many scientists think a big rock hit the Earth. The weather changed, and the dinosaurs could not find enough food.'
Before they went home, they visited the shop. Nam bought a book about dinosaurs, and Linh bought a green toy Stegosaurus.
On the bus, Nam said, 'When I grow up, I am going to be a scientist. I will look for new dinosaur bones!' Linh laughed and said, 'I might help you.' It was a great day.
